{{Quote|I remember the day we were forced to give you up, to protect the clan. Your sacrifice has never been forgotten.|Mother Talzin recalls giving up Asajj Ventress to Hal'Sted|<ref name="Nightsisters (episode)">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Hal'Sted''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. At an unknown time before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he traveled to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], where he met the Nightsister mother Talzin, who chose to hand a newborn Dathomirian [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj]] over to him in order to protect her clan. After leaving the planet, he returned to Rattatak to raise and train Asajj. Hal'Sted was later killed by [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].

==Biography==
At an unknown time before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, Hal'Sted made his way to the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and met with [[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]], the head of a clan of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. In order to protect her clan, she gave him the young [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] left the planet to travel to [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. Some time later, Hal'Sted fell victim to war on the planet and died. Ventress, who was looking for her master Hal'Sted, found the dead body on the street when several Weequay crossed her path, but were attacked by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Ky Narec/Legends|Ky Narec]].
